rules.text: A change to headings 7901 through 7905 from any other heading, including another heading within that group, provided there is a regional value content of not less than 35 percent based on the build-up method or 45 percent based on the build-down method.

(A) A change to tubes, pipes and tube or pipe fittings of heading 7907 from any other goods of heading 7907 or from any other heading, provided there is a regional value content of not less than:
(1) 35 percent based on the build-up method, or
(2) 45 percent based on the build-down method; or
(B) A change to other goods of heading 7907 from any other heading.

warning: Not updated for Pres.Proc. 8771, effective Feb. 3, 2012.
